{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence in upward trends.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price is trending downward — avoid overshoots.",
    "When true outcome spikes upward, reduce forecast peak by 5–10% to prevent overreaction.",
    "If model consistently overestimates prices in the 3rd–5th day of forecast horizon, apply a 3–5% downward bias to correct for lagged mean reversion.",
    "In sentiment > 0.25 periods, increase forecast sensitivity to recent price drops — model should react faster to negative sentiment.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply a 2–3% downward adjustment if true outcome is consistently below forecast in last 3–5 days — indicates mean reversion or market correction.",
    "If forecast shows sharp upward spike followed by true outcome dip, apply a 10–15% correction to prevent overshoot after spikes."
  ]
}
